title: Development and characterization of a functional nanoemulsion using pomelo peel essential oil and curcumin
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00421G, Paper
Open Access

Parismita Koch, Munmi Borah, Sankar Chandra Deka, Poonam Mishra
A nanoemulsion incorporating pomelo peel essential oil and curcumin was formulated. Nanoemulsion had droplet size, PDI and zeta potential of 12.98 nm, 0.287, −22.4 ± 0.20 mV respectively with potent antibacterial and antioxidant property.
